result.rationale: The diff line `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` replaces `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })`, literally inverting the condition, while the adjacent requestedSlug line keeps the same `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` guard. Result: when billing is enabled, both `slug` and `requestedSlug` are set (bypassing the requestedSlug/payment gate), and when disabled no slug is set at all — a behavior inversion with no visible justification elsewhere in this PR.
